Subject: Mid-contract capacity top-up + request to align renewal

Hi Olga,

TL;DR: We need a 30% capacity top-up for the next 6 months and would like to explore co-terming the expanded capacity to our existing renewal (31 Dec 2025). Can Redwood provide pricing options and an estimated pro‑rata invoice?

We had a usage spike in April driven by two pilot projects and expect sustained higher throughput as we roll out the feature across 3 hospital sites. Current forecast: additional ~450M tokens/month (roughly +30% on our reserved tier). Procurement asked me to confirm:
- Is a mid-contract top-up possible without a full contract amendment?
- Can we co-term the top-up to our year-end renewal and have a single invoice?
- Any short-term discount for committing to the top-up for 6 months?

Attached is our usage extract for Q1 that shows the trend. We need an answer in the next week to start our internal PO routing.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call if helpful.

Camila Soto
Director, Cloud Integrations
Atlas Health
procurement@atlashealth.com

Hi Camila — thanks for the details and the Q1 extract. Quick answers up front: yes, we can support a mid-contract top-up and co-term to your Dec 31 renewal; there are two common paths (short amendment vs. staged top-up) depending on how you want billing aligned.

I attached a lightweight uplift calculator (uplift_calc_template.xlsx) so we can model the two approaches. If you can confirm the expected start date for the additional capacity (target: Jun 15?) and whether you want the extra capacity to be billed as a blended rate or as a separate temporary bucket, I’ll get back with a pricing packet and one-page amendment draft.

Proposed next steps:
- You: confirm start date and whether you want the top-up committed for 6 months.
- Me: run pricing options (blended vs. temporary bucket) and share a one‑page amendment + pro‑rata invoice estimate.
- If OK: we’ll send redlined amendment and DocuSign link for PO signature.

If useful I can loop in our pricing lead (Ben) on the options — I’ve cc’d Ben.

Best,
Olga Petrov

Ben / Priyom — forwarding Atlas Health ask. Key facts: Jun 15 start, commit through 2025-12-31 (~6.5 months), +~450M tokens/mo (~+30%). Procurement needs signed amendment by Jun 5 to hit their June invoicing.

Options to price (please run numbers and include pro‑rata invoice estimate):
1) Blended-rate approach: add capacity to their reserved tier and compute new blended unit price for the remainder of the year (good for keeping single invoice).
2) Temporary bucket: create a timebound additional reserved bucket billed separately at a promotional uplift (say X% discount vs list for temporary commits).
3) Hybrid: partial blend + small temporary bucket for surge months.

Constraints / asks from Atlas:
- They prefer blended if uplift < 15%.
- Need PO-ready amendment and DocuSign by Jun 5.

Attachments: I ran a quick baseline in the uplift_calc_template and put notes. Also see the usage_report_q1 they shared.

Can you 1) pick recommended option + rationale, 2) give precise pricing math and 3) provide a one‑page amendment we can send to the customer? I can handle legal redlines but we need the starting doc.

Thanks — Olga

Hi team — running the numbers now. Quick take: blended rate works and is simplest for billing, but the blended uplift is ~12% on unit price (within the customer’s comfort zone). Temporary bucket pricing with a small incentive for committing 6 months comes out slightly higher blended-equivalent unless we offer a targeted discount.

Attached: quick pricing memo and two sample amendment drafts (one blended, one temporary-bucket). I recommend the blended amendment to keep Atlas on a single invoice and reduce procurement friction — saves our CS team time on reconciling multiple buckets.

Key figures (summary):
- Current effective unit price: $0.0042 / 1k tokens
- Blended with +30% capacity (Jun 15–Dec 31): $0.00471 / 1k tokens (~12% uplift)
- Temporary bucket (isolated 450M/mo): $0.00495 / 1k tokens, with 6-month commit discount of 8% off list
- Pro‑rata invoice for Jun (start Jun 15) under blended: $21,400 (estimate, includes partial month)

I’m attaching redwood_midterm_amendment_v2.pdf (one-page blended amendment) and a short internal memo. Priyom — can you check commercial terms for approvals and legal language? If we greenlight, Olga please send to Camila with DocuSign link.

Ben
